top_apps.name: Space Base: Idle Tower Defense
top_apps.description_short: Build & defend your space base, upgrade turrets, survive endless waves. Idle TD.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Build the ultimate space base and hold the line against endless waves of enemies in Space Base — an idle tower defense game with deep turret upgrades and base progression. Place different turret types, unlock technologies and keep earning resources even while offline.

Key features:
- Build and upgrade your space base from scratch
- Multiple turret types: rapid‑fire, splash, freeze and sniper
- Deep tech tree and upgrade system
- AFK progress – earn resources while you are offline
- Epic bosses and special challenge waves
- Endless power growth and increasing difficulty

Plan your layout, combine turret types and find the most powerful builds. The smarter your defense, the further you survive. Download Space Base and protect the galaxy!
